questions.stem: You are a member of a sports club. You are talking to three other members in the sports club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30-40 words.

questions.prompt: When was the last time you played sports?
questions.sample_answer: The last time I played sports was two weeks ago. I played badminton with my friends in my schoolyard, which helped me release stress and unwind after several hours of studying.

questions.prompt: I usually play sports with my friends and watch sports programs. What about you?
questions.sample_answer: I often play various physical activities with my friends, such as football, volleyball, and badminton. I also watch sports programs on television to stay updated about the sports world.

questions.prompt: I like playing sports with my friend, but my brother likes playing sports alone. What do you think about this issue?
questions.sample_answer:
Oh, I think playing sports alone is quite boring. However, I respect your brother’s choice. He can enjoy individual/solo sports such as fishing, swimming, going to the gym, or riding a bike.


Or
Well, I think everyone has their own preferences. But if you ask your brother to play sports with you, I think he’ll still enjoy it. You guys will have a wonderful time together.
